scope: Offline lesson text and bilingual exercises.

lessonsRead.observation: Imperfect difficulty (confundia/pareciam) with porque, then perfeito resolution (desenhou/marquei); cloze subjects 'Uma vizinha'/'eu' visible before gaps, recall has one answer with eu given; caption and visual notes withhold map/bakery.

fazia um esforço para + infinitivo in imperfect, passei a + ler for the small change, hoje estudo for constancy; choir example is a distinct transfer; cloze passei/estudo unambiguous with eu as sentence subject.

Ganhei confiança quando + expliquei (perfeito) against procurava (imperfeito); complication 'sabia onde precisava trocar de linha' resolved by consultei/achamos; achamos cue (nós) is form-identical across tenses so no tense trap.

Nossa amizade começou num mutirão, quando nós pintamos; follow-up 'Agora nós cuidamos da horta e a Joana leva' matches the beat's added shared activity; cloze pairs nós/a Joana with visible subjects; 'banco' glossed as bench, distractor 'fila do banco' plays on the contrast harmlessly.

veio de um engano + pensando em names the dúzia/seis mix-up and hoje pergunto/confirmo gives the current handling; recall veio has the full noun subject visible; the eight-o'clock example is a genuine new transfer.

No começo … era sair correndo, mas agora tenho tempo contrasts habits; interlocutor's quando … mudar (regular future subjunctive) stays in the listener turn and is licensed; learner answer saio/mantenho in present, cloze choices distinct.

Meu conselho é + infinitivo with como example, justified by perfeito 'perguntei o trajeto e duas pessoas caminharam comigo'; recall 'pequena' tests agreement with visible 'atividade'; new-neighbour opener does not reveal the advice.

Quero começar um projeto para gravar + quem mora há muito tempo recycles P7 purpose and P8 duration; complication 'por que escolheu' answered with 'ouvi três versões'; recall mora with quem forces 3sg, fallback 'moram' is simply ungrammatical, not a false distinction.

Tenho muita gratidão pela vizinha que guardou expresses thanks without obrigado/a or gendered grato; repayment is concrete (levo meu carrinho e ajudo a transportar); 'sua casa' in the interlocutor turn is você-register consistent with du in German.

A experiência que marcou meu ano foi contar … na rádio do bairro links back to the feira of L1; 'na rádio' (station) vs 'no rádio' (broadcast) are both correct and consistently glossed; closing turn joins change (converso com mais gente) and continuation (quero gravar outras histórias).

The lost streets and the bakery landmark connect practical difficulty with a neighbour’s help. The revised pool model now says the speaker could not find the locker, and both translations reflect that distinction.

Reading on the bus solves the problem of finding a full hour. English now distinguishes the original effort from what the learner does now. Choir rehearsal is a different setting, and the cloze distinguishes I started and I study.

The listener now asks whether the person knew where to transfer, allowing the learner to explain checking the map together. The story no longer claims the listener knew an unmentioned earlier question. Meu caminho and both translations describe the narrator’s route consistently. The drive to the coast transfers the gain-plus-event construction, with Routine gewonnen in German.
Painting the same bench explains meeting Joana, and gardening explains the ongoing friendship. Playing at a bar transfers the shared-event frame. Cuidamos and leva have distinct visible subjects.

A dozen was mistakenly understood as six. The speaker now checks the number before paying. The eight-in-the-evening story transfers the misunderstanding to scheduling. The full translated lines and the distinct gloss for dúzia make the quantities clear.

Rushing out in January contrasts with coffee in the square now. Leaving earlier addresses the coming change to working hours. The library-loan model uses the same contrast in a different setting, and the future subjunctive in the interlocutor’s question remains unblanked.

The learner’s route question and the two companions make the advice actionable. The walking group’s singular caminhada now contrasts with the plausible agreement error saem, and the shared label reads infinitivo. The transfer is advice for a first day at work.

The learner heard three accounts of one event and wants to record residents’ stories. The swimming-class example gives a different goal and purpose. Quem licenses singular mora, and neither other listed person form fits that antecedent.

Storage of the boxes during the flood motivates helping with Saturday’s move. The cart and books show precisely how the learner will reciprocate. Gratidão avoids gendered self-reference and transfers naturally to thanking a teacher.

The radio interview connects an experience, greater social contact and future participation. The German scene now agrees correctly with du, and the cooking-class model is distinct. All ten trophies, caption openings, word limits, exact builds, clozes, recalls and nonfinal chip endings match the signed candidate.

findings.issue: Am Anfang machte ich / eine riesige Anstrengung mirrors the Portuguese construction more literally than the idiomatic full-dialogue German. The single rehearsal also supports sustained effort even though the model would make recurring effort clearer in the plural.
findings.recommendation: Keep the exact signed source. Consider combining the phrase into one idiomatic gloss when revisiting chunk boundaries.

findings.issue: Meu caminho is defensible for explaining one’s own route, as reflected in all linked fields. The transfer gloss 'I gained practice' is intelligible but stiff.
findings.recommendation: Optional later English polish: 'I got some driving practice on the way to the coast.'

findings.issue: The German reports thinking about six eggs, with the intended misconception supplied by context. The six-hours and square-laundry distractors are easy semantic contrasts with the displayed base cue.
findings.recommendation: For future polish, German could explicitly say 'ich dachte, das wären sechs Eier'; a plausible wrong quantity would make a closer build decoy.

findings.issue: The full coffee routine makes the intention clear, although 'keep my coffee in the square' is literal.
findings.recommendation: Optional polish: 'I’ll leave earlier so I can still have coffee in the square' / 'Ich gehe früher los und trinke meinen Kaffee weiterhin auf dem Platz.'

findings.issue: Some split base-language glosses leave a relative clause unfinished. They identify the individual Portuguese chips, and the full translated sentence provides the proper word order and tense.
findings.recommendation: At a future revision, group the relative clause with its object or duration phrase where the chip count permits.

lessonsRead.observation: Street confusion is an ongoing past problem. A neighbour drawing a map and marking the bakery answer the request for what helped. The pool-locker example is a real transfer, but its wording suggests losing the locker itself. Confundia is the only eu form on offer.

The question about lacking a full hour leads naturally to reading on the bus. The imperfect effort model transfers to choir rehearsal. Both finite cloze answers agree with the visible Eu and switch from the past change to the current habit.

Giving directions can explain the gain in confidence. The current wording calls them my route, and the listener knows the stranger asked about a line change before the learner mentions one. The road trip is a genuine new setting for ganhei … quando.

The square cleanup explains how the friendship began, and the garden and seeds show how it continues. The musician partnership transfers the shared-event model, with two clear agreement targets in the closing horticulture scene.

The speaker means six eggs but orders a dozen. Asking and confirming the quantity today answers the neighbour's follow-up. A time-of-day mix-up transfers the misconception to a different setting, with an opportunity to clarify the German of both examples.

A future change to working hours challenges the established coffee routine; leaving earlier makes the intended outcome feasible. The library loan transfers the past-versus-now habit frame. Future mudar appears in the listener's question and is not tested.

The newcomer asks how to approach an unfamiliar walking group, and the speaker describes asking about the route. The first-day-at-work model transfers giving advice. Pequena is uniquely feminine singular, while one build decoy reduces the exercise to spotting a fridge.

Three accounts of the same event give an actual reason for planning the oral-history project. A swimming class transfers the goal-plus-purpose frame. The free relative quem mora is singular and the two closing verbs share the learner's visible Eu.

The neighbour who stored boxes during the flood now needs moving help. Bringing a cart is a concrete, gender-neutral way of reciprocating. Appreciation for the teacher organizing a school event transfers the construction. Guardou agrees with vizinha.

Speaking about the market on community radio leads to talking to more people and wanting to record more stories. The cooking class transfers the experience-plus-infinitive frame. The narrative respects neutral du/você and all planned trophies occur in the relevant first turns.

findings.issue: Perdia o armário / 'kept losing my locker' describes losing a locker instead of being unable to find one's own matching locker. The German word order 'ständig meinen Spind nicht wiedergefunden' is also awkward.
findings.recommendation: Use the taught frame directly, e.g. 'Na piscina eu confundia os armários porque todos tinham a mesma cor.' Translate it as 'Im Schwimmbad habe ich die Spinde verwechselt, weil sie alle dieselbe Farbe hatten' / 'At the pool I kept mixing up the lockers because they were all the same colour.'

findings.issue: 'Today I study every day' obscures hoje meaning nowadays. The supposedly repeated rehearsal effort is localized to a single rehearsal in both base texts.
findings.recommendation: Use 'I started reading on the bus, and now I study every day.' Use 'Nos ensaios do coral…', 'Bei den Chorproben…', 'At choir rehearsals…' to anchor the repeated effort.

findings.issue: The stranger is looking for a station, but the learner says they explained their own route (meu caminho). The listener then knows exactly what this stranger asked next despite hearing nothing about a transfer, while the learner answers only that they found the right station. The English and German glosses repeat the unexplained 'my route'.
findings.recommendation: Use 'expliquei o caminho' for giving directions, ask an open follow-up that requests a new detail, e.g. 'E como você mostrou onde trocar de linha?', then have the answer identify the transfer station on the map; alternatively ask if they could find the station together. Align chunks, models, cloze, and translations. For the driving transfer use 'I got some practice' / 'Ich konnte Fahrpraxis sammeln' instead of 'gained practice' / 'Übung gewonnen'.

findings.issue: The German 'kam aus einem Irrtum' and 'kam aus einem Irrtum: Ich habe acht Uhr verstanden' are calques. 'an sechs Eier gedacht' describes thinking about eggs, not the learner's mistaken interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Use e.g. 'Am meisten habe ich aus einem Missverständnis gelernt: Ich bestellte ein Dutzend Eier und dachte, das wären sechs.' For the transfer use 'Ich kam wegen eines Missverständnisses zu spät: Mit acht Uhr war morgens gemeint, ich dachte aber an abends.' Keep the target's intended facts aligned if editing it too.

findings.issue: 'Keep my coffee in the square' sounds as if the drink is to remain there; 'behalte den Kaffee auf dem Platz bei' similarly obscures maintaining the habit.
findings.recommendation: Use 'I’ll head out earlier so I can still have my coffee in the square' and 'Ich gehe früher los und trinke meinen Kaffee weiterhin auf dem Platz.'

findings.issue: A walking group leaving a refrigerator, washing laundry in the square instead of morning coffee, and a half-dozen hours for the egg order are easily dismissed without understanding the intended Portuguese.
findings.recommendation: For L7 contrast 'que saem da praça' with singular caminhada. For L6 use a real purpose or an agreement contrast tied to a morning schedule, and for L5 use a plausible wrong quantity for eggs. The base cues identify the intended meaning; a different but meaningful stated quantity is fair.

findings.issue: The single shared pattern label ends in German 'Infinitiv', so English readers see a German grammar word.
findings.recommendation: Use Portuguese 'infinitivo' consistently in the three language-independent pattern labels.

findings.issue: L8's English chips form 'of those who live here for a long time' for continuing duration; its German chunks leave 'von Leuten, die wohnen' dangling. L9's 'der Nachbarin, die aufbewahrt hat' cuts the relative away from its object. In L10 the chip 'meu ano foi contar' crosses both the relative-clause object and the predicate, resulting in 'mein Jahr, war das Erzählen'.
findings.recommendation: Use meaningful constituent boundaries in both base languages. For L8 combine 'de quem mora há muito tempo aqui.' into one chip and split the first clause to keep four chunks. For L9 group 'que guardou as minhas caixas'. For L10 use 'A experiência que marcou meu ano' / 'foi contar' / 'a história da feira' / 'na rádio do bairro.' Give each a natural standalone gloss.

findings.issue: The two coordinated verbs disagree: 'sitzt du … und blickt …'.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Am Jahresende sitzt du mit einer Freundin aus dem Viertel auf der Veranda und blickst auf die letzten Monate zurück.'

lessonsRead.observation: Imperfect difficulty (confundia/pareciam) with porque, then perfeito resolution (desenhou/marquei); cloze subjects 'Uma vizinha'/'eu' visible before gaps, recall has one answer with eu given; caption and visual notes withhold map/bakery.

fazia um esforço para + infinitivo in imperfect, passei a + ler for the small change, hoje estudo for constancy; choir example is a distinct transfer; cloze passei/estudo unambiguous with eu as sentence subject.

Ganhei confiança quando + expliquei (perfeito) against procurava (imperfeito); complication 'sabia onde precisava trocar de linha' resolved by consultei/achamos; achamos cue (nós) is form-identical across tenses so no tense trap.

Nossa amizade começou num mutirão, quando nós pintamos; follow-up 'Agora nós cuidamos da horta e a Joana leva' matches the beat's added shared activity; cloze pairs nós/a Joana with visible subjects; 'banco' glossed as bench, distractor 'fila do banco' plays on the contrast harmlessly.

veio de um engano + pensando em names the dúzia/seis mix-up and hoje pergunto/confirmo gives the current handling; recall veio has the full noun subject visible; the eight-o'clock example is a genuine new transfer.

No começo … era sair correndo, mas agora tenho tempo contrasts habits; interlocutor's quando … mudar (regular future subjunctive) stays in the listener turn and is licensed; learner answer saio/mantenho in present, cloze choices distinct.

Meu conselho é + infinitivo with como example, justified by perfeito 'perguntei o trajeto e duas pessoas caminharam comigo'; recall 'pequena' tests agreement with visible 'atividade'; new-neighbour opener does not reveal the advice.

Quero começar um projeto para gravar + quem mora há muito tempo recycles P7 purpose and P8 duration; complication 'por que escolheu' answered with 'ouvi três versões'; recall mora with quem forces 3sg, fallback 'moram' is simply ungrammatical, not a false distinction.

Tenho muita gratidão pela vizinha que guardou expresses thanks without obrigado/a or gendered grato; repayment is concrete (levo meu carrinho e ajudo a transportar); 'sua casa' in the interlocutor turn is você-register consistent with du in German.

A experiência que marcou meu ano foi contar … na rádio do bairro links back to the feira of L1; 'na rádio' (station) vs 'no rádio' (broadcast) are both correct and consistently glossed; closing turn joins change (converso com mais gente) and continuation (quero gravar outras histórias).

findings.issue: Chunk glosses 'Am Anfang machte ich' + 'eine riesige Anstrengung' are a literal split of fazer um esforço; the dialogue translation already gives the idiomatic 'habe ich mich enorm angestrengt', so the literal chunk pair is acceptable as structural scaffolding and no edit is required.

'expliquei meu caminho a uma pessoa' is understandable (the learner's own route) but 'expliquei o caminho' would be the more neutral phrasing; since the German/English, chunks, recall and trophy example are all consistent with 'meu caminho', leave as is.
Transfer example 'eu perdia o armário' reads as losing the locker; German word order awkward.
